steps.title: Complete upstream setup
steps.instruction: Select the data from your copy of Theme Hospital when CorsixTH asks for the original game files.

warnings: This project has not been verified for play through Portcove.

references.title: Set up CorsixTH on Linux
references.instruction: For a separately prepared copy, use the official x86-64 AppImage with FUSE support. Keep it in a writable folder, make it executable and open it yourself. The inspected build needs glibc 2.34 and libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.30. CorsixTH also documents the Flathub package com.corsixth.corsixth for x86-64 and ARM64. Open the installed app and select the folder with your Theme Hospital data. The Flatpak uses its own profile.

references.title: Set up CorsixTH on Mac
references.instruction: Open the upstream DMG and copy CorsixTH.app out of it. The reviewed bundle contains Intel and Apple Silicon binaries. Open the app and select your Theme Hospital data. Keep the complete bundle and open the app directly to play.

references.title: Keep the actual CorsixTH profile
references.instruction: The regular Linux and Mac builds normally use ~/.config/CorsixTH, or CorsixTH under XDG_CONFIG_HOME. A config.path.txt override can change that. Keep config.txt, hotkeys.txt, Saves, campaigns and any custom music or data paths. The Flatpak has a separate config tree under ~/.var/app/com.corsixth.corsixth. Close CorsixTH and preserve the actual profile and originals before updating the external copy.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, CorsixTH asks for your original Theme Hospital data. Keep that folder outside the managed runtime. The Windows player uses its own AppData profile. The Linux AppImage needs FUSE, glibc 2.34 or newer and libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.30. The Linux player uses CorsixTH under XDG_CONFIG_HOME when it is set, or ~/.config/CorsixTH. Back up that profile separately. If CorsixTH reports a temporary copy after a write error, preserve that copy before restarting. Portcove replaces its portable engine and leaves the external profile in place. Use a separately prepared copy for custom or relative save, campaign, level, log or screenshot locations, portable overrides or custom launch arguments. Keep those folders outside the library.
